gate_2_note: ADR-014 Gate 2 selected A_PLUS on 2026-08-22: billing, falling back to shipping only for a customer with no billing address. Under option A those customers would have imported with no address at all despite having usable address data; under option B every customer with both would carry a second address Shopify shows without a billing/shipping label. A_PLUS gives at most one address per customer and leaves nobody with address data addressless.
note: No customer is blocked by an address problem - that is the ratified rule and it is asserted, not assumed. A skipped address removes the address, never the customer. No country value was defaulted, inferred, or invented.
ratified_rule: Customer = IMPORT, Address = SKIPPED_INVALID_COUNTRY; GB never assumed
